text:
sara_sales: Quick heads up — HelixHealth POC moving to contract stage. Legal sent an MSA redline and procurement is asking how PO + signature routing should work. Can someone own routing + initial redline pushback?

mike_legal: I can take the MSA redline. Need to know if customer is insisting on any DPA changes (residency / SCCs) or KMS/HSM language. If they want PHI coverage that changes the ask.

docu-bot: uploaded Helix_MSA_redline_v2.docx (https://redwood.docs/helix/Helix_MSA_redline_v2) :paperclip:

alex_ops: I’ll handle signer routing. Quick q — does finance want a PO before countersign or is an initial e-signature ok? Also any delegated signer requirements?

jordan_finance: They emailed requesting net45. Our POC policy is net30 for credits, but enterprise deals can do net45 with approvals. If they require PO first, we accept a scanned PO with PO# and billing contact.

vince_ps: Pre-sales note: POC explicitly excludes PHI today. If they enable PHI later we will require Private deployment + HSM and an addendum — major cost delta. Heads up for legal. :eyes:

mike_legal: DPA note: customer asked for EU residency and changes to subprocessors. We have standard DPA + SCCs; any subprocessor exceptions must go through security review. Also flagged: they redlined Section 7 (liability cap) to 24 months instead of 12. That’s a hard no from us.

sara_sales: Ok pushing back on liability cap to 12 months. I’ll ask them to accept standard DPA + SCCs. @mike_legal can you prepare a short exception memo in case they escalate? :thumbsup:

mike_legal: Yep. Preparing an exception memo and non-negotiable summary. Will outline: liability cap = 12 months; no KMS escrow demands without SOC/KMS design review; subprocessors require disclosure. ETA EOD.

alex_ops: For signing flow I propose: 1) Sales uploads initial countersigned orderform via DocuSign envelope, 2) Legal countersigns, 3) If they request delegated signer mapping we require PO + exec approval. That avoids stalled rollouts.

jordan_finance: If we move to net45, I’ll escalate to finance head for approval. Please include estimated revenue and credit risk in the note. Also confirm if billing address needs to be EU entity.

vince_ps: I’ll build a quick pricing delta: Dedicated SLA option (+~25% MRR) or Hosted with standard SLA and no latency guarantees. Will attach calc in a sec.

docu-bot: added comment to Helix_MSA_redline_v2.docx at 2167900200

sara_sales: Thanks all. Actions: mike -> exception memo + redline response; alex -> set up DocuSign envelope and signer mapping; jordan -> finance approval if net45; vince -> pricing delta and note on Dedicated SLA option. I’ll reply to customer with the ask and timeline.

mike_legal: Noted. I’ll post the exception memo + one-paragraph summary for the customer thread when ready.

vince_ps: Uploading pricing delta now. Expect a short PDF and a line item with Dedicated vs Hosted pricing.

sara_sales: Great — target is to get countersign by EOW. Will keep you posted. :rocket:
